ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure, the bottom common wire is connected to terminal B. On the left there is a 5 V independent voltage source, whose upper end is connected through a 2 kΩ resistor to the middle node; the middle node also has a vertical 2 kΩ resistor connected to the bottom common node. Between the middle node and the right terminal A is a controlled voltage source, labeled 3V_AB, with polarity positive on the left end and negative on the right end. Terminal A is also connected through a vertical 1 kΩ resistor to the bottom common node B. Reasoning: When finding the Thevenin resistance at terminals A-B, first deactivate the independent 5 V voltage source and replace it with a short circuit. In this way, both the left 2 kΩ resistor and the middle vertical 2 kΩ resistor are connected from the middle node to B, and the two in parallel are equivalent to 1 kΩ. Let the test voltage V_AB = V, that is, the voltage of A with respect to B is V. From the polarity of the controlled voltage source, V_middle − V_A = 3V_AB = 3V, so V_middle = V + 3V = 4V. Treating node A and the middle node as a supernode, the current supplied by the test source equals the current from A through 1 kΩ to B plus the current from the middle node through the equivalent 1 kΩ to B: I = V/1 kΩ + 4V/1 kΩ = 5V/1 kΩ. Therefore R_th = V/I = 1 kΩ/5 = 0.2 kΩ.

method.method_draft: Deactivate the independent 5 V source by replacing it with a short, so the left 2 kΩ resistor and the vertical 2 kΩ resistor both connect the middle node to B and combine to 1 kΩ. Apply a test voltage V_AB = V at terminal A relative to B. From the dependent source polarity in the image, V_middle − V_A = 3V_AB = 3V, hence V_middle = 4V. Treat A and the middle node as a supernode. The current drawn from the test source is the sum of currents from A through the 1 kΩ resistor and from the middle node through the equivalent 1 kΩ path: I = V/1kΩ + 4V/1kΩ = 5V/1kΩ. Therefore R_th = V/I = 1kΩ/5 = 0.2 kΩ.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中底部公共导线连接到端子 B。左侧有一个 5 V 独立电压源，其上端经一个 2 kΩ 电阻连接到中间节点；中间节点还有一个竖直 2 kΩ 电阻接到底部公共节点。中间节点与右侧端子 A 之间是一个受控电压源，标注为 3V_AB，极性为左端正、右端负。端子 A 还通过一个竖直 1 kΩ 电阻接到底部公共节点 B。推理：求 A-B 端的 Thevenin 电阻时，先将独立 5 V 电压源失效，用短路代替。这样左侧 2 kΩ 电阻和中间竖直 2 kΩ 电阻都从中间节点接到 B，二者并联等效为 1 kΩ。令测试电压 V_AB = V，即 A 对 B 的电压为 V。由受控电压源极性，V_middle − V_A = 3V_AB = 3V，所以 V_middle = V + 3V = 4V。把 A 节点和中间节点看作超节点，则测试源提供的电流等于从 A 通过 1 kΩ 到 B 的电流加上从中间节点通过等效 1 kΩ 到 B 的电流：I = V/1 kΩ + 4V/1 kΩ = 5V/1 kΩ。因此 R_th = V/I = 1 kΩ/5 = 0.2 kΩ。
